## FX Portal 1.0.0 — Release Candidate 1

### New
- **Copy and paste effects.** Select one clip and press Ctrl+Space. Under the search bar you'll see every effect on that clip. Click one to copy just that effect, or **Copy all effects**. Then select other clips, open FX Portal, and click **Paste copied effects**. Keyframes and easing come through exactly.
- **Bar opens in the middle of the screen.** Drag it anywhere and it stays there next time. Double-click it to put it back in the middle.
- **Presets apply silently.** Premiere's Paste Attributes box no longer flashes on screen, and applying is faster.

### Install / update
- Already on Beta 2 or newer: it updates itself (or Settings ▸ Updates ▸ Check now). Restart Premiere when it says so.
- New install: download the zip, extract, close Premiere, double-click **Install FX Portal.cmd**.

### Known limits
Windows only · audio presets not yet supported · not code-signed yet (the installer handles it).
